purpose: Two books running in parallel, deliberately: a WIDE research book for statistical power and a NARROW execution book for realistic costs. Signals are discovered on the wide book and only promoted to the narrow book if they survive measured spreads.

research_universe.role: statistical power, cross-sectional pooling, regime discovery
research_universe.cost_model: per-instrument measured where available, else class default

execution_universe.role: the only place a strategy is allowed to be called tradeable
execution_universe.selection_rule: lowest measured median spread 2019+ among the 10 measured pairs, plus GOLD (deepest non-FX liquidity in the panel)

promotion_rule: wide->narrow requires: same sign, >=50% of the wide-book effect size, and net expectancy >= 2x the measured round-turn cost on the narrow book
note: The 5-instrument book is NOT a different bot: it is the same signals with the cost filter applied. A signal that only works in illiquid instruments is a cost artefact, not an edge.
